messages:
marta (sec-lead): heads-up: short scoped pen-test with RedTeamCo on 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT. Scope: readonly evidence pulls, KMS decrypt for artifacts, and full object-level audit trail. Planning a 30min dry-run 2026-04-01 10:00. @pranav @tess confirm RBAC + KMS plan? cc @jon for telemetry.

pranav (infra): prefer ephemeral in-account role (redteam/assessor) with tight trust policy (vendor principals) + max 1h sessions. Permissions: s3:GetObject/ListBucket on redwood-pt-evidence, logs:FilterLogEvents/GetLogEvents for pt groups, kms:Decrypt on specific key. Deny Put/Delete. Will require key policy to allow grant.

Tess (eng-sre): will add explicit Deny for restricted prefixes (/models/*, /generated/*, /ephemeral-uploads/*). Also enable S3 server access logs for the evidence bucket and CloudTrail data events for object reads.

marta (sec-lead): legal: no handing of key material or plaintext. KMS must use Grants scoped to the role and require encryptionContext (e.g., {\"evidence-origin\":\"redteamco\"}). Decrypt audit logs retained 90+ days. @pranav handle grant lifecycle?

pranav (infra): yes. I'll create a one-off KMS Grant in staging scoped to the role with encryptionContext constraint, log the grant ID, and revoke after engagement. Will post CloudFormation snippet. Staging prep ETA: 2026-03-30 EOD.

jon (platform): ensure CloudTrail data events go to locked audit bucket with MFA-delete and lifecycle retention (>=395d). Set CloudWatch Logs retention to 365d for pt groups so we can prove reads during retest.

Tess (eng-sre): sample policy I'll use (trimmed):

```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:GetLogEvents","logs:FilterLogEvents"],"Resource":["arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/pt/*"]},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"]}]}
```

marta (sec-lead): looks good. add explicit Resource excludes for the restricted prefixes and document encryptionContext requirement in the runbook.

pranav (infra): will post CloudFormation and grant revocation job.

Tess (eng-sre): I'll run pre-dry-run checklist and validate assume-role, S3 reads, KMS decrypt audit entries, and CloudTrail object events. Posting checklist 2026-03-31.

marta (sec-lead): action items: 1) pr anav: role + KMS grant in staging (due 2026-03-30) 2) tess: pre-dry-run checklist & runbook (due 2026-03-31) 3) jon: enable CloudTrail data events + S3 access logging (due 2026-03-31) 4) marta: upload vendor principals whitelist (today). Schedule retest 1h slot week of 2026-04-15 after remediation.

jon (platform): invite sent for dry-run 2026-04-01 10:00 PDT. audit-bot will attach notes. :calendar:

audit-bot: automated note - CloudTrail data events enabled for arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence; retention lifecycle configured.

marta (sec-lead): thanks all. leaving thread open for artifacts and final signoff. :wave:
